lines.text: Brendan, I'm just gonna say one thing, i-if Mark's gonna continue to talk to ya, I know that a lotta, a lotta your relatives and friends have told you things, Travis, Steven, through me, Jodi, you got a lot of different things going through your head, a lot of different versions of things and the truth. Do you know what a fact is? Brendan?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: A fact is something that's true. That's something that really happened.
